purpose: Modern (about-2020) spatial source inputs for the PRB TN/Legacy-N experiment. A source marked available is locally present and technically usable; it is not automatically a calibrated nitrogen load.

items.validated: 30 m projected categorical raster; PRB clip is 45,913 x 19,324 pixels. CLCD classes 1=cropland, 4=grassland, 8=impervious.
items.role: Cropland and grassland masks, plus a spatial allocation mask for gridded agricultural sources.

items.validated: China population-count GeoTIFF; 100 m-class 0.00083333333 degree grid, EPSG:4326, Float32, NoData=-99999. The local series is continuous for 2015-2030 on one grid; 2025 onward is projection rather than observation.
items.role: Population allocation; useful for domestic wastewater and human-pressure covariates, but not a measured TN point-source load.
items.download_action: none; retain the WorldPop release metadata and treat future projection years separately.

items.existing_alternative: Twenty-one crop-specific HDF5 files provide 1961-2020 N inputs on a 5 arc-min global grid. Each contains 13 N-input forms (11 synthetic-fertilizer forms, MA manure, and CR crop residue) split between deep and surface placement. HaNi fertilizer NH4/NO3 fields are also local through 2019.
items.role: Modern cropland fertilizer spatial pattern and an independent cross-check/refinement of HaNi.
items.download_action: NPKGRIDS is optional for sensitivity/cross-validation, not a blocking gap for the current Legacy-N build.

items.validated: Twenty-one crop datasets, each with 60 annual 5 arc-min layers for 1961-2020. This harvested area is the matching denominator/allocation field for the local crop-specific N-input product, but it is not the independent CROPGRIDS release.
items.role: Crop-specific allocation weights for NPKGRIDS and later crop-removal estimation.
items.download_action: CROPGRIDS is optional if NPKGRIDS is later used; the current fertilizer product must be paired with its own harvested-area HDF5.

items.existing_alternative: The MA_deep and MA_surface datasets provide crop-specific manure N inputs for 1961-2020; HaNi nmanure_app_crop remains an independent alternative through 2019.
items.role: Modern spatial distribution of manure applied to cropland.
items.download_action: none for a first model; validate the MA units and avoid double-counting MA when summing the 13 N-input forms.

items.preferred_source: Global Pasture Watch plus FAOSTAT manure
items.validated: GPW contains cattle, buffalo, goat, sheep and horse headcount grids for every year 2000-2022. The China FAOSTAT file contains 1961-2023 manure-left-on-pasture N, volatilization and leaching for 15 animal classes with no missing values. GPW does not spatialize pigs, poultry, camels, asses, or mules; use CLCD grassland and documented allocation rules where needed.
items.existing_alternative: HaNi pasture/rangeland manure deposition is local through 2019.
items.download_action: no blocking download; write and validate the GPW-to-FAOSTAT animal crosswalk and quantify the unallocated animal-class fraction.

items.validated: Fourteen deposition variables, including dryNHx, dryNOy, totNHx, totNOy and totN, are complete for every year 2008-2020 (182 GeoTIFFs) on one Albers grid.
items.existing_alternative: HaNi NHx and NOy deposition are local through 2020.
items.role: Independent 2020 atmospheric-deposition product and uncertainty comparison.
items.download_action: none; harmonize units and use exactly one mutually exclusive deposition definition in each model run.

items.role: China-specific cross-validation of atmospheric N deposition, not an additive second deposition source.
items.download_action: optional validation download: obtain the 2020 layer and metadata; compare only after harmonizing units and wet/dry/total deposition definitions.

items.existing_alternative: HYDE 3.2.1 is local and processed through 2015 only; CLCD provides annual modern land cover through 2025.
items.role: Long-run legacy initialization and 2016+ bridge, subject to release-specific temporal coverage verification.
items.download_action: verify the official HYDE 3.5 release, license and actual annual coverage before download; do not assume a 2025 end year from its name.

items.preferred_source: crop production or yield × crop-specific N removal coefficients, spatialized by CROPGRIDS
items.role: Required with gross inputs to compute net agricultural N surplus for the explicit SON Legacy-N model.
items.download_action: add national/provincial crop production series and crop N-content/removal coefficients. CROPGRIDS crop area alone does not provide N removal.

items.preferred_source: crop/pasture-specific gridded BNF or defensible crop-type parameterization
items.role: Required with crop removal before a net agricultural N surplus can be constructed.
items.download_action: obtain and validate a BNF product/parameter set matched to crop classes; it is absent from the proposed modern list.

items.preferred_source: official China municipal/provincial wastewater flow, TN concentration or TN discharge
items.role: Time-varying point-source TN. WorldPop can allocate a proxy but cannot replace this observation.
items.download_action: obtain annual official records and map to facilities/reaches using HydroWASTE as the location inventory.
